incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE: High 95th-percentile tail latency for /v1/generate in us-west1 (p50 120ms -> p95 2.3s). Impacting hosted-api-prod. Auto-page to #eng-oncall and @oncall.
Maria G: seeing it. I'm paged and looking now. Can folks avoid heavy debug posts in this thread until we know scope? :wave:
Sam Yoo: confirmed increased retry rate from clients, some 502 cascades. Pulling logs.
Maria G: grabbing recent traces. Looks like one of the routing shards is experiencing degraded kernels after a deploy 4m ago. Rolling back that shard first.
Aj Patel: on standby if rollback doesn't help. Ping me for takeover.
Maria G: rollback triggered on us-west1-shard-7
ops-bot: deploy-rollback: revert commit 9a1f3b -> started on us-west1-shard-7 by @Maria G
Maria G: rollback complete, rechecking metrics.
Sam Yoo: dashboards show p95 back to 180ms for that shard but global p95 still at ~1.1s. Some traffic still hitting a legacy variant (v1.9-quant) that has higher tail.
Lee Chen: I see a spike of requests being routed to the lower-memory instances due to autoscaler oscillation. Adding a temporary routing weight to prefer fresh-shard pool.
Maria G: added routing override. Observe for 2 minutes.
Maria G: p95 back to 230ms globally now. Customers reporting fewer errors. Marking incident as mitigated for now. Summary: rolling-shard rollback + routing override.
incident-bot: Incident SEV-1 -> mitigated at 1778601620. Incident channel created: #inc-1778601122
Sam Yoo: quick postmortem notes: primary trigger was a deploy that changed kernel selection heuristics; combined with autoscaler churn caused some traffic to fall back to slower variant. Paging noise earlier made it hard to see the shard-level issue.
Aj Patel: +1. We should tune alerts to reduce noise and route only true service-impacting conditions to pages. Proposal:
- page when global p95 > 1.5s AND errors from >3% of callers
- ticket when single-shard p95 > 1s but global OK
- keep immediate page on 5xx spike >2% within 1m
Maria G: sounds reasonable. We should also add a short suppression window on infra churn (10m) after deploys to avoid duplicate pages.
Lee Chen: agree. Also propose new dashboard panels: per-routing-shard p95, routing fallback rate, autoscaler thrash index. I'll add in Grafana.
Sam Yoo: putting suggested alert rules below. We can iterate.
Sam Yoo: ```yaml
# suggested alert rules (prometheus style)
- alert: GlobalHighTailLatency
  expr: (histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, job))) > 1.5
  for: 2m
  labels:
    severity: page

- alert: SingleShardHighTail
  expr: max by(shard) (histogram_quantile(0.95, rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{shard!=""}[5m]))) > 1.0
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: ticket

- alert: Spike5xx
  expr: sum(rate(http_requests_total{status=~"5.."}[1m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[1m])) > 0.02
  for: 1m
  labels:
    severity: page
```
Aj Patel: +1 to rules. For routing, update routing-policy config to include explicit channel mapping so infra alerts go to #eng-infra and service pages go to #eng-oncall. Example snippet:
Aj Patel: ```yaml
routing_policy:
  - match: { alert_type: infra }
    destination: "#eng-infra"
    escalation: "ops-team"
  - match: { alert_type: service }
    destination: "#eng-oncall"
    escalation: "oncall"
```
Maria G: also propose one change to pager duty mapping: if pager triggers during a deploy window (deploy_start..deploy_end + 10m), send a ticket first unless error rate > 3%.
Sam Yoo: I'll scope changes: dashboard tiles, prometheus alerts, and a small routing-policy PR. Estimated effort: 2 engineer-days.
Maria G: assigning tasks: Sam -> alerts + dashboards, Lee -> Grafana tiles + dashboard links in runbook, Aj -> routing-policy PR + PD mapping. I'll prepare the post-incident summary and runbook edits.
Sam Yoo: quick note for post-incident blameless follow-up: include exact deploy hash, kernel-selection diff, and autoscaler logs.
Lee Chen: adding initial dashboard wireframe now. I'll link it here when ready.
Maria G: handoff to @Aj Patel for the rest of the window. I'm going offline for the meeting in 5m. If anything pages escalate to @Aj.
Aj Patel: taking over. Thanks Maria. I will shepherd the routing-policy changes and follow through on the PD mapping.
ops-bot: reminder: create incident ticket and attach metrics snapshots -> /tickets/INC-1778601122
Maria G: thanks everyone. We'll reconvene in the postmortem doc tomorrow. :thumbsup:
